correctness.rationale: Averaging the two initial-sign characteristic functions gives f''+2λf'+v²f=0 with f(0)=1, f'(0)=0. Depolarization commutes with the rotations. In the computational-basis Choi matrix the coherence is the |00><11| entry e^(-κt)f/2, and partial transpose places it in the block with both diagonal entries (1-e^(-κt))/4. Its smaller eigenvalue is the PPT minimum, so equality is entanglement breaking. The initial positive lobe decreases to zero. On each later lobe log(|f|/h_κ) has second derivative -ω²csc²(ω(t-z_j))+[κ/(2sinh(κt/2))]²<0 since t>π/(2ω); the positive set is one interval or empty. The rate quotient vanishes at lobe endpoints, is positive inside, and strictly decreases under translation by π/ω, even without telegraph damping. Its value at the |f| peak and the upper estimate replacing the denominator by the left zero establish the bounds. For fixed λ>0 these squeeze the counting index to within O(1) of the solution of 2e^(-λt)/t=κ (bounded shift of lobe index absorbs the multiplicative error), giving W(2λ/κ). For λ=0 the squeeze is between inverse-time denominators a fixed distance apart and gives the inverse-rate law. At and above critical damping f is positive and strictly decreases for t>0, so only the initial crossing occurs. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 1; 30 propagator/PPT pairs and nine revival count inversions.
residual_risks: These asymptotics are not uniform as λ approaches either boundary; the finite numerical replay is corroboration only.

value.rationale: For a standard exactly soluble noise model combined with a separately calibrated depolarizer, the hierarchy identifies which individual revivals survive. The explicit logarithmic count with a negative log-log correction, and its change to inverse-rate behavior for static noise, quantify a qualitative revival picture with an operationally meaningful channel observable.
